cr_data.provenance:
1918–1986: Georgia O'Keeffe (1887–1986), New York/Abiquiú; the work remained in the artist's possession until her death 
 
1986–1995: Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiú, in the artist's estate, acquired by inheritance from the artist 
 
Since 1995: Städtische Galerie im Lenbachhaus und Kunstbau München, donation from the Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiú 
(Source: Lenbachhaus, 2025)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Stretcher inscription 3 dates 1919 and indicates no. 61 in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition; pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 12. Orientation based on 1987 installation, which differs from that of Stieglitz installation photograph. Although O'Keeffe was not alive when exhibition opened, she participated in the plans for it, which began in the early 1980s. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
